propositions: rebar comment <id> --body-file <path> stores the literal string '--body-file' as the comment body instead of rejecting the flag-like argument, silently discarding the intended content while exiting 0
positional-body commands accept flag-like tokens (beginning with '-') as body content without validation, enabling silent data loss across multiple independent sessions
a body argument that begins with '-' must be rejected with non-zero exit and usage message, with '--' as the documented escape hatch for legitimate '-'-prefixed values

the guard against flag-like positional arguments must be applied consistently across all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) rather than in isolation
a secondary defect compounds the loss: args[:min_args] slicing discards surplus positional arguments, so 'rebar comment <id> --body-file notes.md' loses the body twice and still exits 0
